measured_findings: DeBridgeGate and SignatureVerifier share one ERC1967 ProxyAdmin; its owner is a Safe 5-of-8.
None of the eight Safe signers returns isValid on SignatureVerifier.getOracleInfo — address-level upgrade authority is disjoint from the oracle set.
excessConfirmations/minConfirmations are signature thresholds, not value meters. No pluggable per-message admission module is exposed on the Gate.
Wrong address 0x43dE2d77…0AaADb (checklist typo) has no code; canonical Gate is 0x43dE2d77…f38398aA.
verdict_reasoning: There is nowhere to install a graduated per-message bound without redeployment. Separability of the upgrade Safe from oracles would matter if a position existed; under the fixed census definition this is no position.
